claims: The 2026 Nebraska football Spring Game concluded on March 28 at Memorial Stadium.
The Red Team defeated the White Team 22-17 in the 2026 Nebraska football Spring Game.
The 2026 Nebraska football Spring Game had 27,188 fans.
Quarterback Anthony Colandrea made his debut in the 2026 Nebraska football Spring Game.
Freshman running back Jamal Rule had 121 rushing yards in the 2026 Nebraska football Spring Game.
Jamal Rule had a 75-yard touchdown run in the 2026 Nebraska football Spring Game.
Coach Matt Rhule highlighted the scrimmage as a focused end to a "quiet" spring.
